newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche wants to buy AGF -paper.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche wants to buy AGF -paper.

text.p: A German newspaper reported that Deutsche Bank, Germany's largest commercial bank, wanted to take over French insurance group Assurances Generales de France (AGF).
Citing unnamed sources, Die Welt daily made its prediction in its Wednesday edition. A copy was released ahead of general circulation late on Tuesday.
In Paris, AGF chief spokeswoman Laurence Galb told Reuters in response to a query that AGF "has no information on such an operation."
Deutsche Bank was not immediately available for comment.
The newspaper also said AGF shares had been bought up over the last six weeks and the share had risen by about 30 percent.
Die Welt said that 65 percent of AGF was in the hands of small shareholders.
Some analysts believe that Deutsche Bank is keen to beef up its insurance business.
